items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: Bobby was great. I didn't say he was my favorite, he was one of my favorites.

ctx.x: I read you said that -- I read your-- that Bobby Henderson was your favorite piano player.
Bobby was great. I didn't say he was my favorite, he was one of my favorites. I could never point out no one particular of my favorite for everything, because he was one of my favorite piano players.
The first I got a taste of him was with Lady Day.
